name: GMAT Focus Prep: Mbavane
subtitle: GMAT Focus Prep, Data Insights
shortDescription: Practice all three GMAT Focus sections with original questions, a sortable table, adaptive timed mocks in any order, instant explanations and spaced review.
longDescription:
Prepare for the GMAT Focus Edition the way the exam is built: three sections, 45 minutes each, with the order of your choice.

START IN A MINUTE. A 12-question diagnostic sets your starting level in Quantitative Reasoning, Verbal Reasoning and Data Insights, then practice picks questions near that level and brings missed ones back on a spaced schedule.

EVERY QUESTION TYPE. 700 original practice questions, every number checked by code: problem solving, reading comprehension, critical reasoning (strengthen, weaken, assumption, evaluate, inference, flaw, discrepancy, plan), data sufficiency, multi-source reasoning, table analysis, graphics interpretation and two-part analysis. Our coverage map lists 53 content points and question skills, each with at least 8 original questions, and shows your own accuracy on every one. Every answer has a worked explanation, a short strategy card and a source you can open without leaving the app.

DATA INSIGHTS THAT FEELS LIKE THE REAL THING. Tap a column heading to sort a table, read charts, switch between memo, table and note tabs, and answer several linked questions about the same sources.

PERSONAL, STEP BY STEP. After a practice set the app links you to the material for what you missed and suggests what to study next and why. Follow the syllabus order, or switch to Build-it and learn the same concepts through real problems such as planning a launch budget or running a bakery. Your progress stays on your device.

ADAPTIVE MOCKS. Full mocks use 21 Quant, 23 Verbal and 20 Data Insights questions with 45 minutes per section, six section orders, an optional break, and a review step where you may change up to three answers per section. The next question depends on how you are doing. Short mocks give the same flow in about 45 minutes. Scores shown are rough estimates only and cannot predict an official result.

FREE AND PLUS. About half of the app is free: the diagnostic, practice on every topic and question type, spaced review, the coverage map, the Work-rate lab, two guided builds, your first full mock and every short mock. Mbavane Plus adds unlimited full mocks, the Sufficiency explorer lab, three more guided builds, the weakest-topics map, a study plan after each mock and stretch sets. Plus is one monthly subscription, no free trial. Cancel any time: it stays active to the end of the month you paid for and is not charged again.

Works offline after install. For candidates preparing for graduate business school. Questions are original and have not been reviewed by an outside subject expert.

GMAT is a registered trademark of the Graduate Management Admission Council. This app is independent, is not affiliated with or endorsed by GMAC, and contains no official GMAT questions.
